summary: Reuse authored image asset storage and renderer; source-content bypasses candidate filters and LLM selection, preserving every image occurrence 1:1.
invariants: source-content manifest remains authoritative for image assets and occurrence references
same asset bytes may be deduplicated in storage but each source occurrence is placed exactly once
source unit count equals output slide count
forbidden: apply ordinary authored source-image filters as content-loss policy
use relevance ranking or one-image-per-slide limit
let an LLM choose or omit source image slots
add slides or silently drop image occurrences
